text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":200,"unit":"$","kind":"money","span":"spent $200 on"},{"id":"q2","value":40,"unit":"$","kind":"money","span":"cost $40 each"},{"id":"q3","value":50,"unit":"%","kind":"count","span":"50% more"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"number of blue ties bought = total blue spend divided by cost per blue tie"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1"],"out":"s2","note":"number of red ties = twice the number of blue ties"},{"op":"div","args":["q3"],"out":"s3","note":"convert 50% to a fraction by dividing by 100"},{"op":"mul","args":["s3","q2"],"out":"s4","note":"50% of the blue tie price, the extra cost for red ties"},{"op":"add","args":["q2","s4"],"out":"s5","note":"red tie unit cost = blue tie cost plus the 50% extra"},{"op":"mul","args":["s2","s5"],"out":"s6","note":"total spent on red ties = number of red ties times red tie unit cost"},{"op":"add","args":["q1","s6"],"out":"s7","note":"total spent on ties = blue tie spending plus red tie spending"}],"target":{"kind":"money","scope":"total amount John spent on ties"},"dismissed":[]}
